startDate.description: The start date of the metrics data range (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.description: The end date of the metrics data range (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

granularity.description: The granularity of the metrics data (week/month/cycle).

groupBy.description: The parameter to group the metrics data by (team/author/assignee/epic, and more).

filters.description: The filter array, advised to use the filter array given by the Copy API Request feature.
